videos.description:

#Microsoft’s strategy for the new #Copilot comes down to model choice and company context.

1. Model choice: You can switch between models from different providers (or let Auto mode choose one for the task).
2. Company context: A project update might be spread across 50 Word docs, 7 Teams channels, and dozens of emails. Work IQ helps Copilot find the relevant information, and it only uses what you’re allowed to see.

The goal is AI built for entire companies, with a model that fits the task and the company context needed to complete it.

videos.title: Tools to Improve Your Focus & Concentration | Huberman Lab Essentials
videos.description:
In this Huberman Lab Essentials episode, I explain how the neurochemicals epinephrine, acetylcholine and dopamine contribute to focus and concentration. I discuss tools for improving attention, including sleep, sound, structured work sessions, nutrition, caffeine and deliberate cold exposure. I also describe a brief daily meditation and visual focus exercises that train your ability to refocus when attention drifts. Additionally, I discuss the potential benefits and limitations of supplements, prescription treatments for ADHD, and why taking time to deliberately defocus supports concentrated work.

videos.description: Being single might feel scary, but being in a toxic relationship is often worse. Relationships are amplifiers: a healthy one can make your life better, but a toxic one can make everything harder. Being alone is better than being with someone who makes you miserable.
